nar.cult_of_rest.litany: A choir of low voices repeats a single vowelless syllable. It lasts half an hour.
nar.cult_of_rest.name: The cult of Rest
nar.cult_of_rest.offering: Offerings before a mouthless statue: dried petals and a split chime.
nar.cult_of_rest.vow: Carved vow: “I fall silent so another may hear.”
nar.failed_facility.log: “Log 112: string 7 keeps sounding after shutdown. Dismantling ordered. Disobeyed.”
nar.failed_facility.name: The failed facility
nar.failed_facility.notice: Serrane notice: “Tuning Workshop 4. Singing without a score is forbidden. The last string tightens at three.”
nar.failed_facility.wreck: A brass operator, hugging a flywheel. It still turns by hand.
nar.hunted_creature.cry: A long animal wail that repeats one Serrane word: “mother”.
nar.hunted_creature.name: The hunted creature
nar.hunted_creature.nest: A nest of brass and small bones. Someone was raising young here.
nar.hunted_creature.tracks: Broad tracks that stop mid-stride, as if it had climbed the air.
nar.lost_expedition.camp: Camp mark: a scratched compass and six tally lines. Five are crossed out.
nar.lost_expedition.corpse: A cartographer, notebook open on his chest. Last line: “the echo answers when we do not speak”.
nar.lost_expedition.journal: “Day nine. We ran out of water; the floor sounds hollow. Someone is humming below, and it is not us.”
nar.lost_expedition.last: “…If anyone hears this: do not follow the low note. It is the one following us.”
nar.lost_expedition.name: The lost expedition
nar.tarn_expedition.camp: Tarn's camp mark: a scratched compass and, beneath it, “we follow the low note”.
nar.tarn_expedition.corpse: An expedition member, pickaxe still in hand. A note on the belt: “Tarn knows”.
nar.tarn_expedition.journal: “Tarn, day twelve: we descend after an echo that is not ours. The wall carvings are the Watch's. So are the strike-outs.”
nar.tarn_expedition.last: “Chorister register: 40,000 emptied. Official Watch report: 4,000. Someone corrected a zero. —T.”
nar.tarn_expedition.name: Tarn's expedition
nar.the_experiment.name: The experiment
nar.the_experiment.protocol: Protocol 9: “Voiceless subject. Subject's reaction to the Undersong: none. Undersong's reaction to the subject: listening.”
nar.the_experiment.result: Final tablet: “The subject is not the experiment. The experiment was the silence.”
nar.the_experiment.subject: Breathing, and a young voice: “may I go back to the cylinder? I like the silence.”
